name: Munquet
blurb: Munquet is a lightweight desktop tool for converting and preparing tabular data files with ease.
description:
Munquet is a lightweight desktop tool for converting and preparing tabular data files with ease.

Transform structured data into the efficient Apache Parquet format, reduce file size, merge datasets, and validate column structures — all through a simple graphical interface.

Key features:

• Convert CSV/TSV files to Parquet

• Merge multiple datasets into one

• Validate and rename column headers safely

• Prevent inconsistent or mismatched data

• Batch processing with progress feedback

• Works fully offline

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
